title: CryptoResearch shared grading system
versioning_rule: Never edit a published version in place. Changes go into cr-grading@2 so older reports keep their original meaning.

favorable_anchors.meaning: Exceptional. Strong, recent, independently checkable evidence; no material weakness found.
Strong. Evidence mostly supports it; weaknesses are identified and bounded.
Adequate or mixed. Real positives with material open questions.
Weak. Positives rest on claims, incentives or assumptions not yet demonstrated.
Poor. Evidence points against it, or key facts are contradicted.
Severe. Disqualifying problems or signs of misrepresentation.

risk_anchors.meaning: Extreme risk. Loss is likely or already occurring.
High risk. A plausible single event causes large permanent loss.
Elevated risk. Material exposures with partial mitigation.
Moderate risk. Exposures exist and are reasonably disclosed and mitigated.
Low risk. Exposures are small, disclosed and mitigated.

investment_components.label: Sustainable business demand
investment_components.definition: Durable, organic demand for the product or service that would persist without token incentives, measured by revenue, volume or usage net of incentives and wash activity.
investment_components.resolving_question: What revenue or usage remains over the last 90 days after excluding incentive-driven and wash activity?

investment_components.label: Token value capture
investment_components.definition: How directly and enforceably business success accrues to token holders as implemented today (fee share, buyback/burn, required usage, staking funded by real revenue). Announced but unimplemented mechanisms count only as conditional.
investment_components.resolving_question: Which implemented, on-chain mechanism routes revenue to token holders, and how much has it distributed over a stated period?

investment_components.label: Valuation and supply
investment_components.definition: Attractiveness of the current valuation (market cap and FDV versus revenue, usage and peers) after accounting for circulating supply, unlocks (potential liquid supply), emissions and dilution.
investment_components.resolving_question: What are market cap, FDV and the 12-month unlock schedule, and how do they compare with revenue measured over a stated period?

investment_components.label: Risk resilience
investment_components.definition: Ability of the project and of a spot position to withstand adverse events (credit losses, exploits, regulatory action, liquidity shocks, key-person risk). A separate judgement: it is NOT 100 minus overall downside risk.
investment_components.resolving_question: What happened, or would happen, to the project and the token in its worst plausible single event?

investment_components.label: BTC-relative asymmetry
investment_components.definition: Probability-weighted upside versus downside relative to simply holding BTC over the horizon, from the scenarios. Unproven when credible valuation evidence is missing.
investment_components.resolving_question: Under the stated scenario probabilities and BTC assumptions, is the expected return versus BTC positive, and what valuation evidence supports it?

investment_components.label: Timing and executable liquidity
investment_components.definition: Whether a spot position of the intended size can be entered and exited now at reasonable cost (depth, venues, spreads) and whether near-term timing (unlocks, catalysts, trend) is favorable.
investment_components.resolving_question: What is the 2% order-book depth on the main spot venues, and which unlocks or catalysts fall in the next 90 days?

grade_label_note: Descriptive labels only. They are not trade recommendations and never trigger a purchase.
grade_display_rule: Full precision is stored. The display shows one decimal, truncated (not rounded), so a displayed number never sits in a higher band than its label.

risk_scores.label: Credit risk
risk_scores.definition: Risk of loss from borrower or receivable default, collateral shortfall or credit-process failure. Not applicable outside credit and PayFi profiles.
risk_scores.resolving_question: What are realized default and loss rates per pool over a stated period, who bears first loss, and how concentrated are the borrowers?

risk_scores.label: Dilution risk
risk_scores.definition: Risk that new supply (unlocks, emissions, treasury sales, inflation) reduces holder value over the horizon. Unlocks are potential liquid supply, not demonstrated sales.
risk_scores.resolving_question: How much supply unlocks or is emitted over the horizon, as a share of current circulating supply, and what has happened at past unlocks?

risk_scores.label: Liquidity risk
risk_scores.definition: Risk of being unable to exit a spot position of the intended size at a reasonable price (thin books, venue concentration, delisting).
risk_scores.resolving_question: What is the 2% order-book depth across the main spot venues, and how concentrated is volume on one venue?

risk_scores.label: Overall downside risk
risk_scores.definition: Probability-weighted severity of permanent capital loss over the horizon.
risk_scores.resolving_question: What is the bear-case price and its probability, and which single event would cause it?

rules: Three independent panels: diagnostic categories (higher is better), investment components (higher is better) and downside risk (higher is more risk).
Diagnostic categories are never averaged into the investment grade.
The app, not the model, owns the weights and calculates the grade as the sum of component score times weight.
If any component is unknown or not applicable, no firm grade is shown; weighted coverage is shown instead. Weights are never renormalized and no midpoint is inserted.
A complete set of justified component ranges produces a labeled grade range.
The model-reported overall score is stored separately and never overwritten; differences are flagged.
Risk scores are not averaged into investment quality, and risk resilience is not derived from overall downside risk.
Evidence confidence measures evidence quality. It is not a probability of profit and not a multiplier on the grade.
